sentences: Linear-rank inequalities constrain dimensions of collections of subspaces and their sums.
The recorded question asks whether the associated cones are polyhedral.
Polyhedrality would mean that finitely many linear inequalities suffice to describe the relevant geometric region.
Such a description could turn a broad family of linear-information constraints into a finite system amenable to computation.
